statement: High FUND-001 states are associated with wider commercial-paper-to-Treasury-bill spreads.
rationale: High states have materially wider raw spreads and bootstrap CI is positive.

statement: High FUND-001 states are associated with elevated commercial paper rates relative to trailing context.
rationale: High states show higher CP deviations on average, but MI showed this is not the sole driver.

statement: High FUND-001 states are associated with depressed Treasury bill rates relative to trailing context during some stress windows.
rationale: Some predefined stress windows show positive Treasury-bill contribution, but it is not universal.

statement: FUND-001 represents a mixed funding-spread mechanism rather than a pure commercial-paper funding-cost mechanism.
rationale: High states are distributed across multiple mechanism labels rather than one pure CP-only channel.
